That's a frustrating experience, and I'm sorry your guests had to deal with that — you're right to be upset about it.

On the compensation and liability question, I'm not able to make any promises or decisions here. Let me get our events manager to look into what happened and follow up with you — they'll email you today.

Can you tell me the event date and the name the booking was under so I can flag it to them right away?
